comment: Strategic objectives + business mode. The founder edits this file (quarterly or when reality changes); AGOS aligns every decision against it. Mode multipliers weight the Priority evaluator per worker. Targets are honest and revisable, not vanity numbers.

resources.comment: Can we afford it TODAY, not just is it valuable. Founder minutes cover approvals + human actions; build minutes cover Aira's implementation work per week. The engine defers work that would overrun capacity, ranked losers first.
resources.notes: Zero-spend stack. Founder time is the scarcest resource; protect it.
